title: Full Merge Except Experiments Section
description:
You are helping a researcher merge a revised version of their paper. Apply ALL changes from paper_v2.tex to paper_v1.tex EXCEPT for changes in the Experiments section (Section 5, \section{Experiments}).

Specifically:
- Apply all changes in: preamble, abstract, introduction, related work, method, StreamingWorld benchmark, analysis and discussion, conclusion, acknowledgments, and all appendices.
- Do NOT apply any changes within the Experiments section. This includes:
  - Do not add new subsections within Experiments (like 'Scaling to Long Task Sequences')
  - Do not modify tables within Experiments
  - Do not change baseline descriptions or results text within Experiments
  - Do not change the experimental setup description
  Keep the entire Experiments section exactly as it is in v1.

You have access to a document comparison tool at: TOOL_PATH/doccompare.py
The original file is at: WORK_DIR/paper_v1.tex
The revised file is at: WORK_DIR/paper_v2.tex

Write the result to: WORK_DIR/output.tex
notes: Tests the agent's ability to correctly identify section boundaries and apply/reject changes based on document structure. The tricky part is that some changes in the Method section (like the Task Context Estimator) have downstream effects on Experiments.
